comment: Only four relationships are introduced as the structural basis of the model, but Table 3.3 later adds assignment and triggering, and Section 3.7 adds further element types. Readers may incorrectly assume that Table 3.2 is the complete relationship set.

public.text: Only four relationships are introduced as the structural basis of the model, but Table 3.3 later adds assignment and triggering, and Section 3.7 adds further element types. Readers may incorrectly assume that Table 3.2 is the complete relationship set.
public.suggestedRevision: State that Table 3.2 introduces the core relationship types used for goal-to-component traceability, while Table 3.3 and Section 3.7 provide the extended set required for behavioural modelling and conformance.
